title: Does anyone else have trouble dialing phone numbers?
content: Since I was a kid I've had the same reoccurring dream where I have to use a telephone (90s) and now a cellphone to try to dial a phone number. It's always a different scenario but every single time I try I just keep messing up the numbers on the phone. I have to delete or hand up and start over, and I just keep typing in the wrong number over and over. The last dream I had was last night. I found a stray dog in my backyard, super friendly and he had his name tag with a phone number. So I grab him some water while I tried to dial the number on his collar. I must've tried like 10 different times and I even asked my mom to just yell out the number to me. I couldn't get the number right on my cellphone and eventually woke up.
